verdict.rationale: YYLO keeps data local in open, Git-native forms: code, notebooks, notes and Ledger live in one Git checkout, Ledger records are Git-native, the wiki is Markdown, and workflows can be saved as YAML. A plan/apply flow preserves product history and committed Ledger data, which suggests little lock-in and an easy exit. However, nothing documents an explicit export or offboarding path, and the serialization of typed task and artifact records is not specified. Missing for 10: an explicit documented export/exit procedure, a stated open format for all Ledger record types (tasks, artifacts), and independent or hands-on corroboration of portability.
